integrity: Exact symbolic identity and finite Jacobian ranks reproduced; arithmetic field and orbit statements proved algebraically, without independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Arithmetic classification only for nine canonical same-block embedded configurations; their geometric construction, singularities and freeness are credited to the primary paper. No global all-triples claim and no positive-characteristic claim.
title: Arithmetic descent of the nine Fermat-cubic hyperosculating-conic triples
